What Mom whispered, every night. 🌙

At five, Abigail squeezed her eyes shut, and her mom whispered: "Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid." ✨

At nine, Mom knelt by her bed and reminded her those worries weren't hers to carry. At thirteen, Mom plugged in the night light and whispered it again.

At seventeen, Mom came in to check one more time. Dark. Quiet. And before she could say it, Abigail whispered, "You said it…" 🥹

6,205 nights. Every single one. ❤️

Then one night, in her new room far from home, the worry came back. And she heard it again, because the words were never just Mom's:

"Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid." John 14:27 🙏

His peace could go where Mom couldn't. ❤️ The last voice they hear at night becomes the voice they carry. Give them words to hold.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
